scope: Queries describe mechanisms in existing technical evidence. No question, target number, prior relevance label, production index, or saved recommendation is used to rank candidates. This is a post-hoc development annotation expansion, not a held-out experiment. One seeded random candidate per ordinary topic broadens negative coverage; it must be audited before labeling.
